selection: Two calibration-style strict cases plus the supported maximum-risk case when risk>=0.5; deduplicate; select before native labels
state_law: Uniform selected source, then uniform selected cases in that source; identical for later Single/Dual views; fixed stratified collection, not pooled IID
budget: All 4096 sources and every outcome-blind selected case; 64 draws/case, at most 786432. No stopping at 50/100 positives, backfill, positive-only filtering, automatic extension or old/new pooling.
scope: Shared fixed behavior teacher collection. Count review alone does not authorize PPO. Independent Single/Dual target-view likelihood and reward/gradient audits are required before PPO export. No validation/test opened.
